notes_for_editor: Only tower-specific source is the tnlandforms index (page revised 2016, one compiler). The index says names for towers 73 and above are its author's own, so 'Old Dixie' is a label, not verified as the tower's name. The index gives the elevation (220) with no unit; the story reads it as feet, which fits the rest of the list but is not stated. No source found on build date, staffing, fire history, fate or present condition. Story body is about 135 words and rests on one index source, so consider holding for editor review. Neither register lists a Georgia tower called Old Dixie (checked the full NHLR Georgia list of 29 and the FFLOS Georgia list of 2; both lists are now quoted in evidence). A web search returned an unopened result mentioning Old Dixie School Road near Alma, Bacon County; it may explain the label but is unverified and not cited. The elevation of 220 is read as feet (67.1 m). Coordinates were not checked against any map.
